q: Kill 8 Prowlers and 5 Young Forest Bears, and then return to Guard Thomas at the east Elwynn bridge.
In Defense of the King's Lands
Mountaineer Gravelgaw in the southern guard tower wants you to kill 10 Stonesplinter Skullthumpers and 10 Stonesplinter Seers and report back to him.
Bring 8 Large Candles to William Pestle in Goldshire.
Collect 4 Grizzled Scalps from Grizzled Thistle Bears to the south of Auberdine and place them in Buzzbox 525.
Speak with Commander Althea Ebonlocke in Darkshire.
Martie Jainrose of Lakeshire wants you to kill Bellygrub. Bring her his tusk as proof.
Help Deathstalker Faerleia kill the Pyrewood Council.
Bring 6 Pyrewood Shackles to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
Gather 5 Notched Ribs and 3 Blackened Skulls, then return to Deathguard Dillinger in Brill.
Talk to Jinar'Zillen at Shadowprey Village, and then bring Nataka Longhorn 2 Bloodbelly fish.
Use the Small Brass Key to open Bookie Herod's Strongbox.
Talk to Jinar'Zillen at Shadowprey Village, and then bring Nataka Longhorn 2 Bloodbelly fish.
Bring the Tablet of Ryun'eh to Theldurin the Lost.
Kill 10 Mottled Boars then return to Gornek at the Den.
Kill 12 Dustwind Savages and 8 Dustwind Storm Witches for Rezlak near Drygulch Ravine.
Bring 12 pieces of Light Leather to Veren Tallstrider in Thunder Bluff.
Find Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.
Find Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.
High Executor Darthalia of Tarren Mill is offering a bounty on Clerk Horrace Whitesteed, Citizen Wilkes, Miner Hackett and Farmer Kalaba.
Bring a Razormane Backstabber, a Charred Razormane Wand and a Razormane War Shield to Tatternack Steelforge at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.
Bring 15 Centaur Bracers to Regthar Deathgate, west of the Crossroads.
Kill 7 Young Nightsabers and 4 Young Thistle Boars and return to Conservator Ilthalaine.
Bring 10 Webwood Venom Sacs to Gilshalan Windwalker at Aldrassil.
Bring 5 Scaber Stalks and 1 Death Cap to Barithras Moonshade in Auberdine.
Bring Magmar Fellhew 8 Carved Stone Idols.
Take Darthalia's Sealed Commendation to Varimathras in the Undercity.
Deliver the Unidentified Ore to Ziz Fizziks in the Stonetalon Mountains.
Return to Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar.
Bring the head of Twilight Lord Kelris to Dawnwatcher Selgorm in Darnassus.
Bring the head of Twilight Lord Kelris to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
Retrieve Mythology of the Titans from the Monastery and bring it to Librarian Mae Paledust in Ironforge.
Bring 8 Dentrium Power Stones and 8 An'Alleum Power Stones to Rigglefuzz in the Badlands.
Show Tooga the way back to his wife, Torta.
Talo Thornhoof in Camp Mojache wants Edana Hatetalon's Dark Heart.
Wait for Galvan to finish forging the weaponry.
Find the Prayer to Elune and take it to Astarii Starseeker in Darnassus.
Search Deathknell and the vicinity for 6 pieces of Scavenged Goods, and return them to Deathguard Saltain.
Escort Arei to safety, then speak with Kayneth Stillwind in Forest Song, in eastern Ashenvale.
Give Marshal Maxwell the bad news.
Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay Bael'Gar.
Enter Blackrock Depths and track down Lord Incendius. Slay him and return any source of information you may find to Thunderheart.
Find Lord Incendius in Blackrock Depths and destroy him!
Cleansing of the Orb of Orahil
Kill the Demon of the Orb, then speak with Tabetha.
Slay Highlord Omokk, War Master Voone, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Recover Important Blackrock Documents. Return to Warlord Goretooth in Kargath when the mission has been accomplished.
Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy War Master Voone, Highlord Omokk, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Return to Marshal Maxwell when the job is done.

Find Ras Frostwhisper in the Scholomance. When you have found him, use the Soulbound Keepsake on his undead visage. Should you succeed in reverting him to a mortal, strike him down and recover the Human Head of Ras Frostwhisper. Take the head back to Magistrat
Recover the Silver Dawning's Lockbox and the Mist Veil's Lockbox for Gorbold Steelhand in Auberdine. Both items should be found aboard the wreckage of the ships to the north of the village.
Bring the books Spells of Shadow and Incantations from the Nether to Varimathras in Undercity.
Bring 10 Kodo Bones from the Kodo Graveyard to Bibbly F'utzbuckle at Kormek's Hut.
Donova Snowden in Winterspring wants you to defeat High Chief Winterfall.
Take Bijou's Reconnaissance Report back to Grandmaster Lexlort in Kargath.
Banish 6 Portals at Mannoroc Coven and return to Taiga Wisemane at Shadowprey Village.
Escort Torek on his attack against Silverwing Outpost and Duriel Moonfire, then report to Ertog Ragetusk at Splintertree Post.
Plant 10 Gaea Seeds in Gaea Dirt Mounds, and then return the remaining Enchanted Gaea Seeds to Tammra at Sun Rock Retreat.
Fill the Coated Cerulean Vial at the orange crystal pool in Maraudon.
Fill the Coated Cerulean Vial at the orange crystal pool in Maraudon.
Bring 4 Bolts of Runecloth, 8 Rugged Leather, 2 Rune Threads, and Ogre Tannin to Knot Thimblejack. He is currently chained inside the Gordok wing of Dire Maul.
Bring a Libram of Focus, 1 Pristine Black Diamond, 4 Large Brilliant Shards, and 2 Skin of Shadow to Lorekeeper Lydros in Dire Maul to receive an Arcanum of Focus.
Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.
Hastat the Ancient has asked that you bring him a Mature Blue Dragon Sinew. Should you find this sinew, return it to Hastat in Felwood.

Search Shatter Scar Vale in Felwood for the remains of Kroshius. When you locate the remains, use the Fel Fire near them and await Kroshius' return. When the infernal has awoken, slay him and take from his corpse Kroshius' Infernal Core.
Return the Portals Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.
Paragons of Power: The Confessor's Bindings
Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a Primal Hakkari Sash. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.
Travel to Grom's Monument in the Demon Fall Canyon of Ashenvale and use Grom's Tribute at the base of the monument. Return to Javnir Nashak outside Orgrimmar before the Harvest Festival is over.
Paragons of Power: The Illusionist's Robes
Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a Primal Hakkari Kossack. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.
Kill Morphaz in the sunken temple of Atal'Hakkar, and return his blood to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood. The entrance to the sunken temple can be found in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Bring the Voodoo Feathers from the trolls in the Sunken Temple to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.
Do a chicken emote at Innkeeper Firebrew, and in exchange you'll receive an Ironforge Mint!
Kill 30 Hive'Ashi Stingers and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Combat Task Briefing XII in order to complete this quest.
Slay 30 Hive'Ashi Workers and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Combat Task Briefing III in order to complete this quest.

Kill 30 Hive'Regal Ambushers and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Combat Task Briefing VIII in order to complete this quest.
Kill 30 Hive'Regal Spitfires and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Combat Task Briefing IX in order to complete this quest.
Kill 30 Hive'Regal Slavemakers and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Combat Task Briefing X in order to complete this quest.
Kill 30 Hive'Regal Burrowers and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Combat Task Briefing XI in order to complete this quest.

Bring 15 Cenarion Combat Badges, 20 Cenarion Logistics Badges, 17 Cenarion Tactical Badges and 1 Mark of Remulos to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also attain Revered reputation with Cenarion Circle to be able to complete this quest.
The Changing of Paths - Protector No More
The Changing of Paths - Conqueror No More

Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Command, 2 Idols of Night, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Neutral reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Dominance, 2 Idols of Strife, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Neutral reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

Bring 1 Qiraji Ceremonial Ring, 2 Amber Idols, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Windcaller Yessendra in Silithus. You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
Bring a Shadowcraft Belt and a set of Shadowcraft Gloves to Deliana in Ironforge.
Bring a Shadowcraft Belt and a set of Shadowcraft Gloves to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
Give Deliana your Dreadmist Mask and Dreadmist Robe.
Give Mokvar your Dreadmist Mask and Dreadmist Robe.
Bring a Cord of Elements and a set of Gauntlets of Elements to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
Return to Fenstad Argyle outside the bank in the Undercity.
Return to Aristan Mottar outside the bank in Stormwind's Trade District.
Retrieve a Putrid Vine from the guardian at the bottom of the Sunken Temple and return to Torwa Pathfinder.

Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Bonescythe Waistguard if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Waistguard, 8 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 5 Cured Rugged Hides, 1 Nexus Crystal and 15 gold pieces.

Mataus the Wrathcaster at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Plagueheart Circlet if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Circlet, 15 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 3 Mooncloth and 3 Nexus Crystals.
